game_title: Max Finder Derby – Spirit Stream Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream, a stream of spirits: the druid must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream: a stream of spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Stream, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the best value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about best to power up the druid and open the vine bridge.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Spirit Stream.
